candidates.detail: Integration/on-time extrapolate through gaps beyond300s; Coverage badge separately reports them but does not restrict integrals. Existing zero-fill behavior is explicitly disclosed. Whether additional low-coverage uncertainty policy is required needs specialist review, not silent algorithm replacement.

Partial AC/DC fields are summed with missing channel0; monotonic sum can hide a single channel reset, and zero cumulative difference falls back to power. Need actual signal invariants before classifying as physical-domain errors. Negative heater clamp is explicit existing policy/test, not a sign regression.

Verify Quick view exposes hidden start/end/algorithm state at all narrow allocated widths, keyboard focus and help/export/legend controls, forced colors, contrast and200% text. Authored mobile test is not mounted/native evidence.

Heater energy is a sampled numerical estimate, not a metered loss/pack-temperature rise or net battery-energy measurement. No temperature is used by ThermalTaxSample or analyzer. Page subtitle implies warming-vs-range but no range/temperature model proves that interpretation; review physical explanatory copy with source owner. Do not derive temperature or fabricate heater draw from backend booleans.
